body.x: Big Pictures, together with the DaejeonInformation Culture Industry Promotion Agency, will hold an exhibition for atotal of four days from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri) in Las Vegas, USAat CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT '(BOOTH #52843) to showcase the VR CMS simulator.

'Big Pictures' aims to provide differentiated 3D contents to its customers based on its planning, creativity and technology. The features of 'Big Pictures' VR CMS simulator are as follows. △ Provide high quality software at low price with a customized solution for beginners △ Provide basic operation training for novice construction machinery △ Operate image replay function △ excellence in operational data curriculum remapping and has educational effect

"We are constantly changing tointegrate virtual space and reality," said an official with Big Pictures."We are interested in attracting partners, distributors and investors tobuilders and VCs."
